# Kafka Management Standards

This directory contains standards for managing, monitoring, and operating Apache Kafka infrastructure within the enterprise.
page_texts.4:
[standards/application/integration/kafka-management/README.md#std-app-int-005-integration-monitoring]

### STD-APP-INT-005: Integration Monitoring

Standards for monitoring integration flows, message throughput, and system health in Kafka-based architectures.
page_texts.5:
[standards/application/integration/kafka-management/README.md#std-app-int-006-data-flow-visualization]

### STD-APP-INT-006: Data Flow Visualization

Standards for visualizing data flows, message routing, and topology mapping across Kafka-based integration landscapes.
page_texts.6:
[standards/application/integration/kafka-management/README.md#std-app-int-007-anomaly-detection]

### STD-APP-INT-007: Anomaly Detection

Standards for detecting anomalies, unusual patterns, and potential issues in Kafka message streams and integration behaviors.
page_texts.7:
[standards/application/integration/kafka-management/README.md#std-app-int-008-lsql-transformations]

### STD-APP-INT-008: LSQL Transformations

Standards for using Lenses SQL (LSQL) for real-time data transformations and stream processing in Kafka environments.
page_texts.8:
[standards/application/integration/kafka-management/README.md#std-app-int-009-data-quality-rules]

### STD-APP-INT-009: Data Quality Rules

Standards for implementing and enforcing data quality rules, validation checks, and compliance requirements for Kafka messages.
page_texts.9:
[standards/application/integration/kafka-management/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

These standards ensure:
- Consistent monitoring and observability across Kafka infrastructure
- Reliable data quality and validation
- Effective troubleshooting and anomaly detection
- Standardized data transformations and processing
- Clear visibility into integration flows
